table.name: people
table.purpose: Registry of individuals (volleyball players, judging by names/heights) with personal attributes; each row is one person, referenced by the poker_player table.

Birth_Date.name: Birth_Date
Birth_Date.description: Date of birth of the person, stored as text in the format 'Month Day, Year' (e.g. 'May 26, 1986').

Height.name: Height
Height.description: Height of the person in centimeters (values 182-207, consistent with tall athletes).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the person (first and last name, e.g. 'Aleksey Ostapenko').

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.description: Country of nationality of the person; observed values 'Russia' (6) and 'Bulgaria' (1).

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Primary key of the people table; unique identifier for each person. Referenced one-to-one by poker_player.People_ID.

table.name: poker_player
table.purpose: Poker career statistics for a subset of people from the people table; each row is one poker player.

Best_Finish.name: Best_Finish
Best_Finish.description: Best finishing position in a tournament (1 = first place, values 1-3). The statistical join to people.People_ID is spurious (a finish position coincidentally matching IDs); it is not a real reference.

Earnings.name: Earnings
Earnings.description: Total tournament prize money earned, in dollars (values ~104,871 to ~596,462).

Final_Table_Made.name: Final_Table_Made
Final_Table_Made.description: Number of final tables the player has reached (values 10-42).

Money_Rank.name: Money_Rank
Money_Rank.description: Player's ranking by career earnings (all-time money list rank; values 58-166, lower is better).

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Foreign key to people.People_ID identifying the person who is this poker player; one-to-one with the people table.

Poker_Player_ID.name: Poker_Player_ID
Poker_Player_ID.description: Primary key of the poker_player table; unique identifier for each poker player.
